6Red, Red Pies of SummerBake a summer pie in the Cooking Guild from scratch.
  • 95 Cooking (b)

Bake a summer pie in the Cooks' Guild from scratch by following the steps below:

Required items

  • Pot of flour (sold in the Guild)
  • Pie dish (found in the Guild)
  • Strawberry
  • Watermelon
  • Cooking apple (found in the Guild)
  1. Make pastry dough by mixing a pot of flour with water by using the pot of flour on the pump and drain.
  2. Use the pastry dough on a pie dish.
  3. Add a strawberry, watermelon, and cooking apple to the shell (in that order).
    • The cooking apple can be found in the Guild, the rest needs to be brought from outside.
  4. Bake the raw summer pie.
    • The pie must be baked on one of the ranges of the Cooks' Guild. Using the Bake Pie spell inside the Cooks' Guild will not count.
    • Ranges can be found on the first floor, or after having completed the hard Varrock achievements also on the ground floor.
